verses.original: δὲ Περὶ τῶν χρόνων καὶ τῶν καιρῶν ἀδελφοί ἔχετε οὐ χρείαν γράφεσθαι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: de Peri tōn chronōn kai tōn kairōn adelphoi echete ou chreian graphesthai hymin
verses.literal: Now about the times and - seasons brothers - {we do} not need to write to you

verses.original: γὰρ αὐτοὶ ἀκριβῶς οἴδατε ὅτι ἡμέρα Κυρίου ἔρχεται οὕτως ὡς κλέπτης ἐν νυκτὶ
verses.transliteration: gar autoi akribōs oidate hoti hēmera Kyriou erchetai houtōs hōs kleptēs en nykti
verses.literal: For you {are} fully aware that [the] Day of [the] Lord will come vvv like a thief in [the] night

verses.original: ὅταν λέγωσιν Εἰρήνη καὶ ἀσφάλεια τότε ὄλεθρος ἐφίσταται αὐτοῖς αἰφνίδιος ὥσπερ ἡ ὠδὶν τῇ ἐχούσῃ ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκφύγωσιν
verses.transliteration: hotan legōsin Eirēnē kai asphaleia tote olethros ephistatai autois aiphnidios hōsper hē ōdin tē echousē en gastri kai ou mē ekphygōsin
verses.literal: While [people] are saying Peace and security - destruction will come upon them suddenly like - labor pains on a pregnant woman . . . . . . and vvv vvv they will not escape

verses.original: δέ Ὑμεῖς ἀδελφοί ἐστὲ οὐκ ἐν σκότει ἵνα ἡ ἡμέρα καταλάβῃ ὑμᾶς ὡς κλέπτης
verses.transliteration: de Hymeis adelphoi este ouk en skotei hina hē hēmera katalabē hymas hōs kleptēs
verses.literal: But you brothers are not in [the] darkness so that [this] day should overtake you like a thief

verses.original: γὰρ ὑμεῖς ἐστε πάντες υἱοὶ φωτός καὶ υἱοὶ ἡμέρας ἐσμὲν Οὐκ νυκτὸς οὐδὲ σκότους
verses.transliteration: gar hymeis este pantes huioi phōtos kai huioi hēmeras esmen Ouk nyktos oude skotous
verses.literal: For you are all sons of [the] light and sons of [the] day we do not belong . . . to [the] night [or] to [the] darkness

verses.original: ἄρα οὖν μὴ καθεύδωμεν ὡς οἱ λοιποί ἀλλὰ γρηγορῶμεν καὶ νήφωμεν
verses.transliteration: ara oun mē katheudōmen hōs hoi loipoi alla grēgorōmen kai nēphōmen
verses.literal: So then vvv let us not sleep as the others [do] but let us remain awake and sober

verses.original: γὰρ οἱ καθεύδοντες καθεύδουσιν νυκτὸς καὶ οἱ μεθυσκόμενοι μεθύουσιν νυκτὸς
verses.transliteration: gar hoi katheudontes katheudousin nyktos kai hoi methyskomenoi methyousin nyktos
verses.literal: For those who sleep sleep at night and those who get drunk get drunk at night

verses.original: δὲ ἡμεῖς ὄντες ἡμέρας νήφωμεν ἐνδυσάμενοι θώρακα πίστεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ περικεφαλαίαν ἐλπίδα σωτηρίας
verses.transliteration: de hēmeis ontes hēmeras nēphōmen endysamenoi thōraka pisteōs kai agapēs kai perikephalaian elpida sōtērias
verses.literal: But [since] we belong to [the] day let us be sober putting on [the] breastplate of faith and love and [the] helmet [of our] hope of salvation

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς οὐκ ἔθετο ἡμᾶς εἰς ὀργὴν ἀλλὰ εἰς περιποίησιν σωτηρίας διὰ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoti ho Theos ouk etheto hēmas eis orgēn alla eis peripoiēsin sōtērias dia hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: For - God vvv has not appointed us to [suffer] wrath but to obtain salvation through our - Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: τοῦ ἀποθανόντος περὶ ἡμῶν ἵνα εἴτε γρηγορῶμεν εἴτε καθεύδωμεν ζήσωμεν ἅμα σὺν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: tou apothanontos peri hēmōn hina eite grēgorōmen eite katheudōmen zēsōmen hama syn autō
verses.literal: He died for us so that whether we are awake or asleep we may live together with Him

verses.original: Διὸ παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους καὶ οἰκοδομεῖτε εἷς τὸν ἕνα καθὼς καὶ ποιεῖτε
verses.transliteration: Dio parakaleite allēlous kai oikodomeite heis ton hena kathōs kai poieite
verses.literal: Therefore encourage - and build one - another {up} just as vvv you are already doing

verses.original: δὲ Ἐρωτῶμεν ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί εἰδέναι τοὺς κοπιῶντας ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ προϊσταμένους ὑμῶν ἐν Κυρίῳ καὶ νουθετοῦντας ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de Erōtōmen hymas adelphoi eidenai tous kopiōntas en hymin kai proistamenous hymōn en Kyriō kai nouthetountas hymas
verses.literal: But we ask you brothers to acknowledge those who work diligently among you - [who] care for you in [the] Lord and [who] admonish you

verses.original: καὶ ἐν ἀγάπῃ ἡγεῖσθαι αὐτοὺς ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ διὰ αὐτῶν τὸ ἔργον εἰρηνεύετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai en agapē hēgeisthai autous hyperekperissou dia autōn to ergon eirēneuete en heautois
verses.literal: - In love hold them in highest {regard} because of their - work Live in peace with one another

verses.original: δὲ Παρακαλοῦμεν ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί νουθετεῖτε τοὺς ἀτάκτους παραμυθεῖσθε τοὺς ὀλιγοψύχους ἀντέχεσθε τῶν ἀσθενῶν μακροθυμεῖτε πρὸς πάντας
verses.transliteration: de Parakaloumen hymas adelphoi noutheteite tous ataktous paramytheisthe tous oligopsychous antechesthe tōn asthenōn makrothymeite pros pantas
verses.literal: And we urge you brothers to admonish the unruly encourage the fainthearted help the weak [and] be patient with everyone

verses.original: Ὁρᾶτε μή τις ἀποδῷ τινι κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ ἀλλὰ πάντοτε διώκετε τὸ ἀγαθὸν καὶ εἰς ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰς πάντας
verses.transliteration: Horate mē tis apodō tini kakon anti kakou alla pantote diōkete to agathon kai eis allēlous kai eis pantas
verses.literal: Make sure that no one repays - evil for evil - Always pursue what [is] good - for one another and for all [people]

verses.original: χαίρετε Πάντοτε
verses.transliteration: chairete Pantote
verses.literal: Rejoice at all times

verses.original: προσεύχεσθε ἀδιαλείπτως
verses.transliteration: proseuchesthe adialeiptōs
verses.literal: Pray without ceasing

verses.original: εὐχαριστεῖτε ἐν παντὶ γὰρ τοῦτο Θεοῦ θέλημα εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: eucharisteite en panti gar touto Theou thelēma eis hymas en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Give thanks in every circumstance for this [is] God’s will for you in Christ Jesus

verses.original: μὴ σβέννυτε Τὸ Πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: mē sbennyte To Pneuma
verses.literal: vvv Do not extinguish the Spirit

verses.original: μὴ ἐξουθενεῖτε προφητείας
verses.transliteration: mē exoutheneite prophēteias
verses.literal: vvv Do not treat prophecies {with contempt}

verses.original: δὲ δοκιμάζετε πάντα κατέχετε τὸ καλὸν
verses.transliteration: de dokimazete panta katechete to kalon
verses.literal: but test all things Hold fast to what [is] good

verses.original: ἀπέχεσθε ἀπὸ παντὸς εἴδους πονηροῦ
verses.transliteration: apechesthe apo pantos eidous ponērou
verses.literal: Abstain from every form of evil

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης Αὐτὸς ἁγιάσαι ὑμᾶς ὁλοτελεῖς καὶ ὑμῶν ὁλόκληρον τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ καὶ τὸ σῶμα τηρηθείη ἀμέμπτως ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: de ho Theos tēs eirēnēs Autos hagiasai hymas holoteleis kai hymōn holoklēron to pneuma kai hē psychē kai to sōma tērētheiē amemptōs en tē parousia hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Now {may} the God - of peace Himself sanctify you completely and {may} your entire - spirit - - soul and - body be kept blameless at the coming of our - Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: ὁ καλῶν ὑμᾶς πιστὸς καὶ ὃς ποιήσει
verses.transliteration: ho kalōn hymas pistos kai hos poiēsei
verses.literal: The [One who] calls you [is] faithful and [He] will do [it]

verses.original: Ἀδελφοί προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi proseuchesthe peri hēmōn kai
verses.literal: Brothers pray for us as well

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἐν ἁγίῳ φιλήματι
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe pantas tous adelphous en hagiō philēmati
verses.literal: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss

verses.original: Ἐνορκίζω ὑμᾶς τὸν Κύριον τὴν ἐπιστολὴν ἀναγνωσθῆναι πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς
verses.transliteration: Enorkizō hymas ton Kyrion tēn epistolēn anagnōsthēnai pasin tois adelphois
verses.literal: I charge you [before] the Lord [to have this] letter read to all the brothers

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: The grace of our - Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you
